card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic.

name: Trump Takes Iowa
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican.

name: South Carolina
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican. +1 Republican for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.

card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Through 2023, Democrats ran ahead of their usual margins in special elections across the country, by double digits on average.

card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Republican, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: By the end of 2023, Trump led the Republican primary field in national polls by more than 40 points.

card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: A forceful address in which Biden took on his doubters. His campaign said it raised $10 million in the next 24 hours.

name: The Joe Rogan Experience
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Republican, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Trump sat for three hours with the country's biggest podcaster, reaching an audience of tens of millions.

name: Biden Steps Aside
card_text: +2 neutral, +3 Democratic. +1 Democratic for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Biden ended his campaign and endorsed Harris. Democrats united behind her within days.

name: Bank Your Vote
card_text: +2 neutral, +3 Republican. +1 Republican for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Republicans, who had shunned early voting in 2020, urged supporters to vote early and by mail.

name: Inflation Cools
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Consumer prices rose 3.4 percent over 2023, down from a peak of 9.1 percent in June 2022.

name: Mortgage Rates
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Thirty-year mortgage rates hovered near 7 percent, more than double their level of three years before.

name: The Chip Factories
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: CHIPS Act grants went to Intel, TSMC and Samsung for new chip plants in Arizona, Ohio and Texas.

name: The Price of Groceries
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Inflation slowed, but prices did not come down. Voters still paid far more at the checkout than before the pandemic.

name: Under Four Percent
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Unemployment ended 2023 at 3.7 percent, below 4 percent for nearly two years running.

name: Tariffs on Everything
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Trump floated tariffs of 60 percent or more on Chinese goods, on top of a 10 percent tariff on all imports.

name: The Fed Signals Cuts
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: The Federal Reserve held rates and projected three cuts in 2024. Markets rallied.

name: Out of Reach
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Home prices kept setting records, and first-time buyers were priced out of market after market.

name: Loan Forgiveness
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: The administration had approved $167 billion in student debt relief for 4.75 million borrowers.

name: No Tax on Tips
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: In Las Vegas, Trump promised to end federal tax on tips. Harris later adopted the idea.

name: The Raleigh Plan
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Harris proposed $25,000 toward first homes and a federal ban on price gouging for groceries.

name: No Tax on Overtime
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: In Tucson, Trump added overtime pay to his list of income he would exempt from tax.

name: Record Highs
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic. Gain a story costing 4 or less from the exchange. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: The S&P 500 closed at a record for the first time in two years.

name: Drill, Baby, Drill
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Republican. Gain a story costing 4 or less from the exchange. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Trump promised to unleash American energy, and pressed Harris on her 2019 support for a fracking ban.

name: The Fed Cuts
card_text: +3 neutral, +2 Democratic. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: The Federal Reserve cut rates by half a point, its first cut since 2020.

name: The Economy Gap
card_text: +4 neutral, +2 Republican. Gain a story costing 5 or less from the exchange. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Through the fall, polls found more voters trusted Trump than Harris on the economy.

name: On the Picket Line
card_text: +1 neutral, draw 1 card. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Biden joined striking autoworkers in Michigan, the first sitting president to walk a picket line.

name: The Mug Shot
card_text: +1 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Booked in Fulton County, Trump turned his mug shot into merchandise. His campaign said it raised $7.1 million in days.

name: The 1864 Law
card_text: +1 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Arizona's Supreme Court revived a near-total abortion ban from 1864. The legislature repealed it within a month.

name: The Bitcoin Conference
card_text: +1 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: In Nashville, Trump promised crypto voters a friendly White House and a national bitcoin stockpile.

name: The Respect for Marriage Act
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Biden signed a law requiring every state to recognize same-sex marriages performed in any state.

name: The Bud Light Boycott
card_text: +2 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: A conservative boycott over a transgender influencer's promotion knocked Bud Light from its place as America's top-selling beer.

name: The Write-In
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Left off the New Hampshire ballot, Biden still won its primary as a write-in, with about two votes in three.

name: Eagle Pass
card_text: +2 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Trump and Biden visited the Texas border on the same day, hundreds of miles apart.

name: The Coconut Tree
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: A 2023 Harris remark about context became a meme as Democrats began to talk of her replacing Biden.

name: The Atlanta Debate
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican, draw 1 card.
flavor: Biden's halting performance on CNN set off weeks of calls for him to step aside.

name: Abortion on the Ballot
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +2 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Since Dobbs, abortion rights had won every statewide ballot measure: Kansas, Michigan, Ohio and four more.

name: The Bronx Rally
card_text: +2 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +2 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Trump drew thousands to Crotona Park, in a borough no Republican presidential nominee had carried in a century.

name: Swift Endorses Harris
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic, draw 2 cards. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Taylor Swift endorsed Harris after the debate, signing as a childless cat lady. Her link sent about 400,000 visitors to vote.gov.

card_text: +1 neutral. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 wealth.
flavor: In an AP-NORC poll, 77 percent of adults said Biden, then 80, was too old to be effective for four more years.

card_text: +1 neutral. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 wealth.

card_text: +1 neutral. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 wealth.

card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 wealth.

card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 wealth.
flavor: In the Philadelphia debate, Trump repeated a debunked claim that migrants in Ohio were eating pets.

card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 wealth.

flavor: Democrats made the Heritage Foundation's plan for a second Trump term a campaign theme. Trump said he knew nothing about it.

flavor: Elon Musk bought Twitter in October 2022 and renamed it X. Its feed and its owner became forces in the campaign.

card_text: Stays in play for the rest of the game. Ongoing: at the start of each of your turns, +1 neutral. Every other outlet gets +1 Democratic at the start of each of its turns.

flavor: Four years after trying to ban the app, Trump opened a TikTok account and gained millions of followers.
